findings.title: Main idle lock retains ordinary seller-key authority when the sole copy must be kept
findings.classification: main-only; corrected in release/completion and latest selected privacy candidates
findings.conditions: Loaded main-branch seller keys reach inactivity timeout while there is no verified recoverable copy. Ordinary authority is also not revoked while the asynchronous custody check waits.
findings.impact: Tag vault and view inputs lock, but ordinary secret APIs can still use the retained seller keys. The retained state therefore lacks the authority suspension now provided by latest code. No live compromise or runtime reproduction is claimed.

evidence.description: No-recoverable-copy branch returns without revoking seller authority.
Secret access checks only current keys; version guard has no expiry/suspension check.
Latest ordinary access rejects suspension; separate backup-only guard.

findings.remediation: Backport latest synchronous suspension, expiry checks and stale async guard invalidation before treating main idle timeout as an authority lock. Keep sole-copy recovery narrow.
findings.acceptance_criterion: Safe lifecycle tests show ordinary signing/scanning/raw export and old guards reject immediately at expiry despite unresolved custody storage; encrypted recovery remains available.

findings.title: Out-of-range archived receipt issue time can fail history rendering
findings.classification: still current in main and all selected recent snapshots
findings.conditions: An authenticated same-seller/same-chain reconciliation archive contains a positive safe-integer issuedAt in seconds outside JavaScript Date range.
findings.impact: Import accepts the value and history calls unguarded toISOString, which can throw RangeError and interrupt that UI. No fund impact or stored-byte corruption established; this is not an unauthenticated network path.

evidence.description: issuedAt at line93 is positive safe integer only.
Import bounds archivedAt only, not issuedAt.
Preview/activation use document validator without another issue-time bound.

findings.remediation: Bound issuedAt at schema/import to representable seconds, and safely render existing incompatible records without throwing or discarding valid unrelated records. A Date-converted positive value may not exceed 8,640,000,000,000 seconds.
findings.acceptance_criterion: Valid boundary timestamps display; invalid values are refused before commit or safely represented from old storage. History does not throw and valid records remain available.
findings.deduplication: Payment reviewer first identified renderer; custody confirmed import chain. Publish once.

findings.title: Older supplemental backup cleanup can erase newer unrelated clipboard content
findings.classification: full-profile supplemental helper; fixed in quick-hide/privacy snapshot, still present in main/release/completion/clipboard-only heads
findings.scope: SecretBackup serves preserved Bitcoin/Solana/TRON test wallets outside core lean mode; explicitly assigned shared helper, not a core release blocker by itself.
findings.conditions: After backup copy, another application/page replaces clipboard before Hide/Lock/unmount or a delayed retry.
findings.impact: App-local generation alone does not establish current clipboard ownership; unconditional empty write removes newer unrelated content.

evidence.description: Retry and cleanup use unconditional writeText at59.
Global lock retries after originating view is gone.
Current helper stores digest and requires matching reads plus ownership; denied reads do not clear.

findings.remediation: Backport conditional clearing where the supplemental helper remains supported. Preserve unrelated content on changed/denied reads.
findings.acceptance_criterion: Safe mocked-clipboard tests verify changed content and denied reads never cause clearing writes. External OS read/write races remain best effort.

findings.title: Backup-only idle retention deliberately preserves recovery without a prior credential for a sole copy
findings.classification: current documented design tradeoff; not an additional ordinary-session bypass
findings.conditions: Retained sole-copy keys have no verified recoverable copy or existing tied encrypted-vault credential.
findings.impact: Encrypted backup/save remains available with a newly chosen backup passphrase. This protects recoverability but is not full confidentiality against someone controlling the already-open tab. Ordinary signing/scanning/raw/payment export are separately revoked.

evidence.description: Existing-vault proof only required when record exists.
Explicitly permits recovery and rejects ordinary/raw/payment exports.

findings.remediation: Use precise retained-recovery language. If full unattended-tab confidentiality is required, establish a wrapping credential before sole-copy payment use or require completed backup. Do not destroy the sole copy to achieve a lock label.
findings.acceptance_criterion: UI accurately discloses retained recovery, ordinary authority remains revoked, and ordinary reuse requires defined import/unlock.
